· Above SMA100 ($72,691.75) and SMA200 ($71,918.98): maintaining long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (43.2%) + current price level historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (64.8→52.0): cooling from overbought, moving towards neutral.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-66.7560→-565.3751): continued weakness, worsening.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $84,380.4): consolidating around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($82,570.72): based on Pivot S1 ($79,806.95) and SMA50 ($80,812.95).
· Swing Resistance ($86,429.35): approaching R1 ($86,833.8) resistance.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.43x): lethargic movement, reduced confidence.
· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, conditions for waiting due to lack of direction.
